topic.title: Advanced Topics
topic.shortdesc: Font embedding, accessibility, image optimization, and internationalization — the features that separate a functional EPUB from a professional one.

body.p: The previous chapter covered the fundamentals: installation, basic transformation, and the structural mapping between DITA and EPUB. This chapter goes deeper into the features that matter for commercial-quality output.

A minimal EPUB — one with valid structure and correct content — is achievable with almost any transformation tool. What distinguishes a professional EPUB is the attention to detail: font embeddingcustom fonts that match your brand, image optimizationoptimized images that keep file sizes manageable, accessibilityoverviewaccessibility metadata that makes the publication usable by everyone, and internationalizationlocalization that respects the reader's language.
The dita2epub plugin provides all of these capabilities through a set of configuration parameters. This chapter explains each one, with examples and recommended settings for common scenarios.
body.note: The features described in this chapter require careful testing with multiple EPUB reading systems. Not all readers support all features equally — font embedding behavior, in particular, varies significantly across platforms. Always test with your target readers before publishing.
